changeReason: V1 selected correction events as if they were obsolete assertions. V2 inherits lifecycle-headroom-v2.0 and selects only candidate units that mention a gold obsolete value before its correction/deletion boundary. Models, sample size, thresholds, and uncertainty method are unchanged.
population: forgetting-bearing Memora questions where the frozen MemoryCore Base top-5 contains at least one value-matched assertion predating its gold correction/deletion event

evaluation.judgeMode: single fixed judge; all criteria for one answer batched in one JSON response
